name: ToolHive
description: Runs MCP servers in isolated containers locally or on Kubernetes, with a CLI, desktop UI, operator, registry, and gateway that apply secrets, auth policy, and telemetry for teams.

skills.name: Run MCP Servers
skills.description: Starts MCP servers from container images, registry entries, or package managers inside isolated containers with `thv run`.

skills.name: Secrets Management
skills.description: Stores encrypted secrets with `thv secret` and injects them into MCP server containers without exposing local credentials.

skills.name: Client Configuration
skills.description: Registers managed MCP servers with AI clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code automatically through `thv client`.

skills.name: Kubernetes Operator
skills.description: Deploys MCP servers and registries on Kubernetes through CRDs with OIDC SSO, audit logging, and OpenTelemetry metrics.
